environment.description: Container deployed via Kubernetes CronJob on GKE Autopilot cluster. Pod security context specifies readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. No emptyDir, hostPath, or tmpfs volumes are defined in the pod spec. The container's ephemeral storage request is 0 and the node enforces ephemeral-storage limits via kubelet eviction. The GKE Autopilot node pool applies a default seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) which restricts certain syscalls but does NOT block network or file-read operations. Container runs as non-root (runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 65534). The service account has no special IAM bindings. Note: the readOnlyRootFilesystem setting prevents any write operations to the container's root filesystem including /tmp, /var, /etc - there are no writable mount points in the pod specification whatsoever.
